basic_info.description: Handsome Edwardian building in the heart of Noe Valley, just one block from the vibrant 24th Street shopping corridor. This classic duplex features two full-floor flats over a garage. The lower unit is vacant and move-in ready. The light-filled flat has coved ceilings in the living room and new flooring throughout. The front bedroom is framed by a bay window, while the spacious primary bedroom opens directly to a private deck. A vintage kitchen leads to a charming breakfast room. The full bathroom includes a shower over tub and a new vanity. Additional features include an in-unit laundry room and access to the low-maintenance yard. With a Walk Score of 97, this location is truly a walker's paradise. Enjoy easy access to public transit, neighborhood shops, and beloved local eateries. On the market for the first time in generationsdon't miss this incredible Noe Valley opportunity.
